text:
anya: Quick heads-up — triage run found ~27 low-effort doc issues (broken links, curl snippets out-of-date, missing codeblocks). Thinking a 2-hour 'tidy and queue triage' this Friday. Who can help? :sparkles:

sam: Can you paste the scan results? scope? only docs/ or runtime guides too?

anya: Mainly docs/ and runtime guide examples. Quick classification: 12 dead links, 8 curl/snippet mismatches, 7 tiny frontmatter/alt text. Not infra-level. Here is the scan output (short): https://internal.kb/scan/6965432100 :link:

kb-bot: automated-scan: https://internal.kb/scan/6965432100 — 27 findings — created backlog label 'kb-tidy-6965' — issue #4521

anya: Proposed plan:
- Friday 10–12am PT
- folks pick tickets <=10 LOC
- tiny PRs (<5 files) preferred
- use PR title prefix: [kb-tidy]

Sam — can you reserve the merge window? :pray:

sam: Yep, will mark the two-hour merge window. I'll also open a tracking PR template in repo. Quick ask: can we include a sed snippet to fix the most common curl problem? e.g. replace old host with new host

anya: Nice — use this in the PR description:
```
sed -i 's|https://api.redwood-old.com|https://api.redwood.com|g' docs/**/*.md
```
That covers most examples.

lucas: happy to pick up curl snippets and runtime guide examples. I'll do a first pass tonight and open small PRs Friday morning. :rocket:

olivia: I'll take dead links (images and internal anchors). Quick note — if you change frontmatter, please run `yarn docs:build` locally to avoid regressions.

anya: thx! Also small docs hygiene checklist to include in PR description:
- link verified
- image loads in staging
- frontmatter author preserved
- add 'kb-tidy' label

If you want to claim specific files, reply with the path. I'll maintain an assignment list.

lucas: claiming docs/runtime/quickstart.md and docs/examples/curl.md

olivia: claiming docs/handbook/onboarding/images/* (image 403s)

sam: I'll create the tracking issue and add merge window. ping me here when PRs are ready so I can coordinate.

anya: Awesome. If anyone only has 15–30 mins, there's also a batch of single-line anchor fixes under docs/legacy/anchors.csv — easy wins.

kb-bot: reminder: weekly doc-scan scheduled for Mon 07:00 UTC — next run: 6965496000

anya: Cool — will post a short follow-up with assignment table. Thanks all! :clap:
